entries.text: Designed the information architecture and metadata model for GM's enterprise data discovery portal, bringing reports and datasets from siloed ETL, BI, governance, and storage teams into one place and cutting data discovery from days or weeks to minutes.
Partnered with data governance and business units to build metadata standards into the data management lifecycle, improving lineage visibility.
Designed a custom metadata model for the enterprise data portal, borrowing tags, labels, and definitions from SKOS, OWL, and DCAT so the system could adopt those standards later with little rework.
Designed data models, semantic models, and data definitions across multiple computing environments to support enterprise analytics and reporting.
Facilitated workshops with different business verticals to capture and clarify legacy terminology and address definition conflicts, reducing confusion when searching centralized repository.
Wrote rules for evaluating the quality of user provided information of library entities (title, description, tags, etc.), to hold owners accountable for clearly identifying their content.
Incorporated security requirements into application architecture, ensuring data protection and access controls met enterprise security standards
Reframed a request for a report-finding website as a metadata supply problem, shifting effort from navigation features to sourcing metadata from upstream systems.

Collaborated with business and data science teams creating high-value, AI/ML data analysis tools, improving operational efficiency for multiple business streams, contributing to 100’s of millions in cost savings.
Designed low-code machine learning model execution platform, reducing IT dependency and accelerating data science processes.
Built a Power BI dashboard tracking usage of the DREAMS ML model-execution platform, giving leadership data to evaluate adoption and set priorities.
Designed scenario setup, filtering, and side-by-side comparison for an ML forecasting tool producing up to 100 scenarios across 90+ product lines, replacing manual spreadsheet matching.

Chosen to repair a six-month conflict between a critical business team and an IT project team. Interviewed, listened, and collaborated with business partners to address their grievances and design a new solution by the end of the week acceptable for both parties.

Designed the information architecture for a deployment-readiness platform that captured project details once and tied each required document to its approval gate, replacing a packet of redundant forms.
Designed and built a prototype content management system for developer documentation, standardizing how development teams wrote and shared technical content.
Designed an interface for exploring large GIS datasets, helping analysts identify optimal locations to expand GM's EV charging network.
Redesigned the Dynamics 365 interface and object model around the sales process for international dealerships, removing clutter and speeding up invoicing.
Contributed to the refinement of reusable UI components for enterprise-level design system, partnered with developers so components are as technically feasible as they are visually consistent.

Conducted comprehensive usability and accessibility (WCAG) testing at all stages of product lifecycle (design, implementation, post-release) and coached QA teams on usability principals, catching costly mistakes earlier.
Validated keyboard navigation, screen reader compatibility, color contrast, and ARIA implementation across enterprise applications.
Ran usability tests across the product lifecycle — recruiting participants, facilitating sessions, and turning findings into design changes.
Reviewed backlog with product owners and stakeholders directly to identify and clarify user story requirements reducing the risk of carry-over caused by insufficient information or design.
Led workshops with business partners, architects, and cross-functional teams to identify complex technical and functional requirements for enterprise application systems.
Produced design documentation — architecture diagrams, annotated wireframes, interaction specs, and handoff guides — for clean design-to-development handoff.

Invited to speak at organization-sponsored, “storytelling with data” user group, demonstrating how to make abstract concepts and numbers more informative and engaging, so stakeholders are more invested in acting on their findings.
Effectively presented technical and design information to diverse audiences, from new college hires to executive leadership, tailoring communication for optimal clarity.
Translated research findings and design decisions into business implications for executive leadership, informing key product decisions.

Mentored team members in advanced design practices like evaluating project scope/cadence, advocating their work, and communicating their ideas in the intricate and intimidating nature of large-scale corporate environments.
Represented GM as a recruiter for the University of Texas at Austin. Attended multiple career fairs, screened dozens of resumés, and made recommendations for promising candidates.
Became a Workplace of Choice Champion, leading "Booster-Shot" sessions for a team of 20+ people to support the company culture shift and establishment of the GM Behaviors.
Scheduled, observed, and analyzed "diagonal slice" meetings providing leadership details on how to address Workplace of Choice survey results and increase employee satisfaction.

Volunteered to lead small group discussions as part of GM's larger, Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) initiative, highlighting how critical feeling safe at work is, as well as the importance of modeling the behaviors required to do it.
Led UX strategy for enterprise data and reporting tools, working with product, engineering, and executive teams to simplify data discovery and access.

Designed wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups in Figma and Axure for enterprise data platforms, AI/ML tools, DevSecOps compliance systems, and CRM customization (Microsoft Dynamics 365), balancing business requirements with technical feasibility

Architected information systems and domain models for enterprise platforms, defining object relationships, taxonomy structures, configuration logic, and system behaviors. Established scalable IA foundations engineers built upon across multiple product iterations.
Led design reviews across concurrent projects, turning stakeholder feedback into design direction and keeping teams aligned.
Led qualitative research on how different user groups work with complex enterprise systems, using findings to shape information architecture.
Analyzed usage data and behavior patterns to identify improvements and inform feature prioritization.
Prioritized and sequenced features by business impact, user needs, and technical dependencies, balancing new work against technical debt and defects.
Designed content for enterprise platforms — navigation, system messages, error messages, and onboarding flows — to reduce cognitive load and support self-service.
Defined content standards, voice guidelines, and editorial workflows for enterprise knowledge systems to keep content consistent.
Used analytics and user research to validate content decisions, with dashboards tracking content effectiveness.
Translated business objectives into analytics solutions, working with stakeholders to define information needs and design reporting.
Created knowledge-sharing platforms and internal training resources used across departments.
Ran technical workshops and training sessions, turning complex requirements into clear guidance for varied audiences.
Designed information architecture for enterprise CRM (Microsoft Dynamics 365), AI/ML platforms, DevSecOps compliance systems, and developer documentation CMS.

Consulted with small business clients on e-commerce and product catalog UX, redesigning information architecture for more intuitive browsing structures and advising on process improvements for product tracking and inventory workflows.

Building business process automation solutions for a law firm using Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI, SharePoint), including automated court filing approval tracking and dynamic trial schedule management.

entries.theme: Qualitative research on health information seeking
entries.text: Led qualitative research on health information-seeking behaviors; contributed findings to new design frameworks for patient information systems.
Conducted over 25 personal interviews and analyzed data from over 40 interviews, finding trends and patterns significant to the hypothesis and unexpected areas of focus for future investigations.
Managed advertising, recruitment, and screening of study participants to ensure time and resources were not wasted on gathering unreliable or redundant data.

Published study on how healthcare providers from a broad range disciplines view the same patient information differently, emphasizing the importance of keeping health information flexible and adaptable.
Conducted usability study for electronic medical records company, presented updated designs to increase speed and reliability of drug prescription process.
Analyzed complex qualitative datasets using NVivo, synthesizing insights to inform information system design and knowledge organization strategies.
Created digital documentation solutions for various internal departments reducing confusion and loss of information.
Designed and built a custom Microsoft Access database for high school counselors to track student interventions, keep case notes, and pull up emergency contacts faster than paper files.

Helped staff better utilize the student information database for quicker information integration (generating email groups, syncing records, importing data into test management software), eliminating time intensive and error prone manual entry.
Worked directly with end-users to efficiently (and calmly) troubleshoot and resolve a wide range of technical issues.
Managed IT infrastructure for 2,000+ student district including Active Directory administration, hardware provisioning, helpdesk operations, and network administration.
Developed training resources and instructional content enabling staff to efficiently access and utilize critical systems during high-pressure situations
Supported 3D printer operations: driver installation, network configuration, software setup, and test prints.
Trained in traditional and modern metalworking including forging, welding, grinding, finishing, and heat treatment in professional ornamental ironworks shop
Completed hands-on certification courses: metal lathe, wood lathe, milling machine, CNC machining, shears, roll breaks, laser engraving
Design and fabricate large-scale interactive installations including functional high-striker and decorative ballista using metalworking and woodworking techniques
Operate personal fabrication shop with oxy-acetylene torch, MIG welder, miter saw, band saw, bench grinders, and belt sanders
Developed precision metalworking skills: soldering, casting, raising, chasing, and engraving with precious and non-ferrous metals
Interviewed 24 stakeholders across development, design, marketing, and test teams at four sites to define what each group needed from UI guidelines and why past efforts had stalled.
Coded interview data in RQDA (~300 segments, ~90 codes) and affinity-mapped themes into content, delivery, and process requirements.
Designed the content model for a UI guideline library: a base schema with Control, Behavior, Concept, and Dialog types sharing facets for usage, keyboard input, accessibility, and localization.
Specialized DITA and wrote XML schemas so guidance could be authored as small, reusable answers and published to multiple formats from one source.
Wrote 18 control guideline pages for a SharePoint wiki and drafted 40+ more control, behavior, and concept topics, each with usage criteria and keyboard behavior.
Scoped and presented the project — an MLIS Professional Experience proposal and a fall 2012 poster — with weekly status reports to the design manager.
Designed a descriptive metadata schema and controlled vocabulary for metalsmithing techniques, then classified sample techniques and documented where the schema broke down.
Identified that keeping UI guidance current mattered as much as writing it, and proposed a contributor-driven content model so teams could add and update guidance themselves.

summary.headline: Senior UX Designer & Information Architect
summary.text: UX Designer and Information Architect with 12+ years designing complex enterprise systems. Strong foundation in IT infrastructure (10 years) combined with expertise in user experience, information architecture, and metadata governance. Proven ability to translate business requirements into scalable solutions that prevent costly rework. Specialized in designing intuitive systems for large organizations where "shared vocabulary doesn't mean shared meaning" is the core problem to solve. MLIS from UT Austin.

education.degree: Master of Library and Information Science (MLIS)
Bachelor of Arts (BA) in Psychology, Minor in Jewelry & Metalsmithing
